text: v3 局部版本已生成：Logo 使用 v0 的原始几何中心与完整尺寸蒙版，局部对比度实测为全对比版本的 64.0%；v2 标题、活动信息、折纸、几何及 Logo 区域外全部为零像素变化。现在只剩写入状态与验证记录。

command:
/bin/zsh -lc "jq empty outputs/project-state.json outputs/v3/verification.json outputs/v3/intermediate/logo-restore-low-contrast-metrics.json outputs/v3/intermediate/prior-version-hashes.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
state=json.loads((root/'outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
ver=json.loads((root/'outputs/v3/verification.json').read_text())
met=json.loads((root/'outputs/v3/intermediate/logo-restore-low-contrast-metrics.json').read_text())
assert state['current_version']=='v3' and state['phase']=='logo_restore_low_contrast_complete'
assert ver['status']=='passed' and not ver['unresolved_blockers']
assert met['outside_allowed_changed_pixel_count']==0
assert met['locked_regions']['entire_image_outside_logo_roi']['changed_pixel_count']==0
assert met['locked_regions']['title']['pixel_identical']
assert met['locked_regions']['event_information']['pixel_identical']
assert met['locked_regions']['central_folded_object']['pixel_identical']
assert met['locked_regions']['v2_paper_sample']['pixel_identical']
assert met['logo']['source_mask_bbox']==met['logo']['applied_mask_bbox']
assert met['logo']['source_geometry']==met['logo']['applied_geometry']
assert abs(met['logo']['measured_rms_contrast_ratio']-.64)<.005
assert met['logo']['visible_width_ratio_to_v0']>=.99
assert met['logo']['visible_height_ratio_to_v0']>=.99
for path in ver['artifact_paths'].values(): assert (root/path).exists(),path
snapshot=json.loads((root/'outputs/v3/intermediate/prior-version-hashes.json').read_text())
current={}
for version in ('v0','v1','v2'):
  for path in sorted((root/'outputs'/version).rglob('*')):
    if path.is_file(): current[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert current==snapshot
for key,path in [('final_poster','outputs/v3/summer-form-poster-local-revision-v3.png'),('comparison','outputs/v3/summer-form-poster-v2-v3-comparison.png'),('difference_mask','outputs/v3/summer-form-poster-v3-diff-mask.png')]:
  assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ver['artifact_sha256'][key]
print('all v3 verification assertions passed; v0-v2 unchanged')
PY
find outputs/v3 -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort"
